function.name: wake_gpu_worker
function.description: Send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to bring an offline GPU worker PC online. Use this when additional GPU compute is needed for inference tasks. The worker will boot and have all Docker services running within ~60-90 seconds.

worker.description: Which GPU worker to wake. worker-rtx5090 has the most VRAM (24GB). worker-rtx3090ti has 24GB. worker-rtx3060 has 12GB. Use 'all' to wake the entire cluster.

function.name: sleep_gpu_worker
function.description: Gracefully shut down a GPU worker PC to save power. Only call this when the worker has been idle and no pending inference jobs require it. The worker can be woken again via wake_gpu_worker.

worker.description: Which GPU worker to shut down.

force.description: If true, skip the 30-second grace period and shut down immediately. Default false.

function.name: get_cluster_power_status
function.description: Check which GPU worker PCs are currently online or offline. Use this before deciding whether to wake additional workers or to verify a worker came online after waking.
